definitions.gloss: personal belongings; carry-on items; personal effects
definitions.explanation: Items that a person carries with them, especially when traveling. Commonly seen on signs and in announcements at airports, stations, and public facilities.

examples.japanese: {携帯品|けいたいひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{携帯品|けいたいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please cooperate with the inspection of your carry-on items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{携帯品|けいたいひん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}さない→離す：19372_hanasu⟧ようにして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: At the airport, please do not leave your personal belongings unattended.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧ (carrying, portable) and ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item, article). This word is commonly seen in formal announcements, signage, and regulations at airports, train stations, and other public facilities.

Note that while ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧ is commonly associated with mobile phones in casual speech, in {携帯品|けいたいひん} it retains its original meaning of "things one carries."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {携帯品|けいたいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: inspection of personal items
- {携帯品|けいたいひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: watch your belongings
- {携帯品|けいたいひん}⟦{申告|しんこく}→申告：03687_shinkoku⟧: declaration of personal effects (customs)
- {携帯品|けいたいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧: bringing in personal items

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧: hand luggage, carry-on baggage — specifically luggage brought aboard transportation
- ⟦{所持品|しょじひん}→所持品：20346_shojihin⟧: belongings, possessions on one's person — more formal; used in legal and police contexts
- ⟦{身|み}の{回|まわ}り→身の回り：07854_minomawari⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: personal effects — everyday items one keeps close; slightly more informal
